oracle-risk.name: Oracle AI risk management practice, September 2026

requirements.question: Check that recovery exercises record results and corrective actions; a backup configuration or successful backup alone does not test recovery.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Backup and recovery evidence maps to SOC 2 A1.2, ISO 27001 A.8.13, and NIST CSF PR.DS-01.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates environmental protections and backup processes support availability objectives with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

requirements.question: An inventory identifies data but does not demonstrate its protection. Require the protection decisions and tested enforcement for the same inventory scope.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Knowing what data is held and where is the precondition for every other data obligation.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Processing-activity records evidence exists within freshness SLA and covers every in-scope system.

requirements.question: Bind disposal proof to the confidential-data inventory, retention decisions, disposal method, and completion records; do not accept a policy alone.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Retention limits and secure disposal are assessed separately from encryption.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.7.3 (Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

requirements.question: Require explicit fraud scenarios and analysis. A generic risk register may omit fraud even when its normal risk assessment workflow passes.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Formal risk assessment aligns SOC 2 CC3.2, ISO 27001 A.5.8, NIST CSF ID.RA-01, and HIPAA 164.308 risk analysis.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates risk to objectives is identified and analyzed with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

requirements.question: Software change authorization does not cover all changes to the control environment. Check organizational, operational, regulatory, and technology change impacts on risks and controls.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Controlled changes to production systems map to SOC 2 CC8.1, ISO 27001 A.8.32, NIST CSF PR.DS-01, and FedRAMP CM-3.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates changes to infrastructure and software are authorized and tested with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

requirements.question: Compare the control-assessment and detection candidates separately. Monitoring security events does not by itself evaluate whether the internal control system continues to function.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Assess controls with an appropriately independent assessor against an approved assessment plan, and report the findings and recommendations.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Attested evidence: the approved assessment plan, the assessor's independence statement, and the latest assessment report with findings. No assessment within the defined cycle is stale evidence.

operating_contract.objective: Security monitoring and anomaly detection align across SOC 2 CC7.2, ISO 27001 A.8.16, PCI DSS Req 10, NIST CSF DE.AE, and FedRAMP AU-6.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring, runtime policy, audit, or alert evidence exists and unresolved high-risk monitoring failures are tracked.

requirements.question: Check access authorization, changes, removal, role restrictions, and review results. MFA configuration alone does not establish the complete access lifecycle.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Logical access restrictions and MFA are assessed across SOC 2 CC6, ISO 27001 A.5.15, NIST CSF PR.AA, FedRAMP AC-2, CIS IAM, and HIPAA access management.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current identity, access review, privileged access, or authorization policy evidence exists and has no open high-risk failure.

requirements.question: Security detection is not the same as preventing unauthorized access from outside the system. Require boundary/access safeguards and their enforcement evidence, with detection treated as a separate contribution.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Security monitoring and anomaly detection align across SOC 2 CC7.2, ISO 27001 A.8.16, PCI DSS Req 10, NIST CSF DE.AE, and FedRAMP AU-6.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring, runtime policy, audit, or alert evidence exists and unresolved high-risk monitoring failures are tracked.

requirements.question: A vulnerability scan does not necessarily test anti-malware protections. Identify endpoint coverage, detection/prevention configuration, update health, and response validation.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Vulnerability identification and remediation spans SOC 2 CC7.1, ISO 27001 A.8.8, PCI DSS Req 11, NIST CSF ID.RA-01, and CIS AWS logging/monitoring.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates vulnerabilities are identified and remediated with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

requirements.question: Require documented event analysis, classification, and disposition. Collection of alerts without analysis cannot establish this catalog topic.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Security monitoring and anomaly detection align across SOC 2 CC7.2, ISO 27001 A.8.16, PCI DSS Req 10, NIST CSF DE.AE, and FedRAMP AU-6.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring, runtime policy, audit, or alert evidence exists and unresolved high-risk monitoring failures are tracked.

requirements.question: Evaluate incident handling separately from privacy notification. Notification timers alone do not demonstrate incident containment, investigation, and response execution.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Declare incidents against defined criteria, then triage, categorize, escalate, contain, eradicate, and close them with root cause, preserved evidence, and lessons learned.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Derived from `siem-alerts` incident signals joined to `ticketing` or `jira-ticketing` incident records. An incident without an owner, past its triage or containment SLA, or closed without root cause is an open violation.

operating_contract.objective: Breach notification obligations align GDPR Art.33, SOC 2 privacy criteria P3.2, and HIPAA remediation planning.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Incident-response runbook + breach-notification evidence exists; unresolved high-severity incidents have notification timers tracked.

requirements.question: Tie restoration and verification to actual incident scenarios. A backup record without incident recovery decisions and validation is incomplete evidence.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Backup and recovery evidence maps to SOC 2 A1.2, ISO 27001 A.8.13, and NIST CSF PR.DS-01.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates environmental protections and backup processes support availability objectives with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

requirements.question: Check current notices against the actual processing inventory and delivery to affected audiences. Review the two privacy candidates independently to avoid counting overlapping summaries as complete evidence.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Publish privacy notices at collection and on change, and obtain and record valid consent wherever consent is the basis for processing.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Attested evidence: the current published privacy notices with version history and change notifications, plus consent records showing what was consented to, when, and how withdrawal is honoured.

operating_contract.objective: Transparency and data subject rights are privacy obligations with no security-control equivalent.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Evidence for GDPR Art.12 exists within freshness SLA.

requirements.question: Require traceable choices, consent status where applicable, withdrawal handling, and their enforcement in the processing workflow. A notice alone does not establish the choice mechanism.

requirements.question: Trace collected data fields and sources to stated processing purposes and the permitted collection design. An inventory alone does not establish collection limits.
requirements.source_scope: vendor implementation context, not verified normative equivalence

operating_contract.objective: Maintain records of processing activities that state each purpose, lawful basis, data categories, recipients, and retention, and limit collection and use of personal information to those stated purposes.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Attested evidence: the current records of processing activities list, per processing activity, purpose, lawful basis or authority, data categories, recipients, and retention, with the date of last review.

requirements.question: Trace actual uses to the approved purposes and investigate deviations; a processing record that merely lists intended uses is insufficient.

requirements.question: Inspect documented processing objectives and specifications and their approval. This is the shared safeguard's evidence anchor; do not automatically extend it to all processing stages.
requirements.source_scope: no target-specific vendor reference found

operating_contract.objective: Inputs, processing, and outputs are complete, accurate, timely, and authorized — SOC 2's Processing Integrity criterion, which no confidentiality or availability safeguard covers.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates processing specifications define complete and accurate processing objectives with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.
